newsitem.title: USA: Hospitality Worldwide to buy Leonard Park.
newsitem.headline: Hospitality Worldwide to buy Leonard Park.

text.p: Hospitality Worldwide Services Inc said on Monday it planned to buy Leonard Parker Co, a privately held purchasing company for the hospitality industry, for common shares and convertible preferred stock.
The company said it would issue 1.25 common shares and $5 million par value preferred stock convertible into one million shares of common stock at Monday's market prices.
There are about 7.065 Hospitality shares outstanding.

Leonard Park acts as an agent for the purchase of about $250 million of goods and services for its customers each year, Hospitality said. It had revenues of over $40 million for the most recent 12-month year, the company said.
The acquisition was expected to be completed in early 1997, Hospitality said.
